The 427880 cleanup contract is composed from existing FULL427110 resize and current-backing source free. The older mesh-only no-grow fragment is not used, so negative signed capacity is not silently ignored.
Record payload uses32 forward DWORD loads/stores matching REP MOVSD overlap propagation, not a memcpy/memmove substitution.
Record reserve has no cleanup of newly allocated backing/previous copies on allocation failure inside a later string copy; native unwind calls bare RET401130.
